# YK Door Solutions

> > YK Door Solutions (yunngd.com) provides UL and CE certified fire-rated doors, windows, and shutters with comprehensive technical documentation and global service coverage.

YK Door Industry Co., Ltd. specializes in manufacturing fire safety products compliant with international standards including UL, CE, GB, and IBC certifications. The company serves commercial, industrial, and military projects worldwide with steel and wooden fire doors, fire-rated glass assemblies, roller shutters, and security door solutions.

## Key Topics

- Fire-rated doors and assemblies
- UL certification (UL 10C)
- CE marking and CPR compliance
- Fire door standards (GB, IBC, NFPA 80)
- Steel fire doors
- Fire windows and glazing limits
- Fire roller shutters
- Door closers and hardware
- Commercial building fire safety
- Fire resistance ratings
- Declaration of Performance (DoP)
- UKCA certification
- Fire door installation
- Security doors
- International fire safety regulations

## Fire Door Standards & Certification

- [Fire Door Standards Comprehensive Guide](https://www.yunngd.com/2024/08/15/fire-door-standards): Complete guide to fire door standards: GB, UL certifications and compliance
- [CE Marking and Fire Rated Performance](https://www.yunngd.com/2025/05/15/european-standard-fire-doors): CE marking compliance for fire doors per EN 14351-1 and BS EN 16034
- [CE Marking Requirements for Fire Doors](https://www.yunngd.com/2025/05/15/ce-marking-requirements-for-fire-doors): CE marking requirements per CPR EU 305/2011 for fire door manufacturers
- [You Can Tell the Rating on a Fire Door by](https://www.yunngd.com/2025/06/02/you-can-tell-the-rating-on-a-fire-door-by): Guide to identifying fire door ratings via UL labels and IBC requirements
- [Fire Rated Glass Doors: Glazing Limits and Integrity Requirements](https://www.yunngd.com/2026/02/20/fire-rated-glass-doors-glazing-limits-and-integrity-requirements): NFPA 80 and IBC glazing limits for fire-rated glass door assemblies
